questions.question: How should we restructure the work currently bundled in #1026?

options.label: Rescope #1026→TIME, spin off CPA + capabilities
options.description: Rewrite #1026 as the ready-to-build TIME adapter issue (corrected premises). Create 2 new issues: CPA pricing acceptance (decoupled from #1027) and 'advertise supported_pricing_models in get_adcp_capabilities'. TIME ships now; CPA/capabilities tracked cleanly in the right families.

options.label: Keep #1026 as umbrella + child issues
options.description: Leave #1026 as a tracking parent (corrected), and create child issues for TIME, CPA, and capabilities-advertising under it. More structure and more tracker items, but a single parent to watch.

options.label: Rewrite #1026 in place (TIME+CPA together)
options.description: One corrected issue covering both models' adapter acceptance; split out only the capabilities-advertise piece. Minimal tracker churn, but TIME stays coupled to CPA's slower settlement discussion.

options.label: Close #1026 as done + open fresh issues
options.description: Close #1026 (serialization delivered by #1473), open clean product-scoped issues from scratch for TIME, CPA, capabilities. Cleanest slate, but loses #1026's history/epic linkage and could read as 'done' when adapter work remains.
